purpose: 展示两侧实际帮助说明，包括合法字符与转义写法；具体措辞不作为新增验收要求。
output:
usage: darksafe [demo|version|ingest|help]

commands:
  demo     run the bundled access-decision demo
  version  print the version
  ingest   batch-ingest metric samples from standard input
  help     show this help

ingest input:
  Standard input is read line by line. Writes and queries may alternate;
  queries only read data committed by earlier successful write lines and
  never change storage. Blank lines produce no result but still count toward
  line numbers. Accepted data is held in memory for this process only and is
  never written to disk. A single line may contain at most 67,108,864 raw
  bytes (64 MiB); the line separator is not counted, so a line of exactly
  that length is still processed. A longer line always fails as one whole
  line: it is never split into multiple inputs and even a valid JSON prefix
  is never treated as a complete request, so it writes no points and runs no
  query. It still produces one error result, data committed by earlier lines
  is retained, and later lines continue to be processed in input order.

  Write line: a JSON array of sample objects; each line is one batch.
  A sample is {"name": string, "timestamp": <int64 milliseconds>,
  "value": <finite number>} and may optionally include
  "labels": {"key": "value"}. Empty label values are preserved verbatim;
  omitting labels and passing an empty labels object both mean no labels.
  Missing fields, wrong types, unknown fields, duplicate keys, illegal
  numbers, or input that is not a JSON array fail the whole batch.

  Every string (metric names, label keys and label values, in both write
  arrays and query objects) must be valid text: the raw bytes must be valid
  UTF-8, and a \uXXXX Unicode escape must denote a real character. A lone
  high surrogate, a lone low surrogate, or a high surrogate not followed
  immediately by a valid low surrogate is rejected; it is never repaired into
  U+FFFD. (A backslash-escaped as \\uD800 is ordinary text, not an escape.)
  Chinese text, supplementary-plane characters written literally or as a
  matched surrogate pair, and a deliberately typed U+FFFD or \uFFFD are all
  valid. Corrupt text fails the whole line as a parse error with no index and
  no conflict even if earlier samples in the array were valid: no point from
  that line is committed and a corrupt query returns no matches. The error
  distinguishes invalid UTF-8 bytes from invalid surrogate escapes.

  A series is identified by metric name plus its full label set; label order does
  not matter. Submitting the same series/timestamp with the same value is a
  duplicate (1 and 1.0 are equal) and is ignored; a different value rejects the
  entire batch without overwriting anything. Any failure in a batch discards all
  new points from that line; earlier successful batches remain in effect.

  Query line: a JSON object {"op":"query","name":"cpu",
  "start":1000,"end":2000,"labels":{"host":"a"}}. op, name, start and
  end are required; name is an exact, non-empty metric-name match and start/end
  are inclusive int64 millisecond bounds (start == end queries that one
  timestamp; start > end is rejected). labels is optional: omit it or pass {}
  to match every series of the metric; otherwise every given key must exist with
  exactly the same value (extra series labels are allowed, and an empty string
  only matches a label that actually exists with that empty value). Names and
  labels are matched verbatim without trimming or case folding.

ingest output (one JSON line per non-empty input line, in input order):
  write ok: {"status":"ok","added":N,"duplicates":N,"series":[...]}
           where every known series is listed with name, labels and timestamp-
           sorted points; series are ordered by name and then by sorted labels.
  query ok: {"status":"ok","op":"query","series":[{"name":...,
           "labels":{},"count":N,"average":N.N}]} — one entry per series
           having points in range, in the same series order, with the full name
           and label set; an empty match yields []. The arithmetic mean is taken
           over stored float64 values and is always finite for finite inputs.
  failure: {"status":"error","line":N,"index":M,"error":"...",
           "conflict":{...}} — index is the 1-based sample position and is
           omitted when the whole line cannot be parsed or for query lines;
           conflict reports the series, timestamp, existing and submitted values.
           An over-long line reports the size limit as a whole-line error with
           no index and no conflict.

  Processing continues after a failed line. The command exits non-zero if any
  line failed, and zero when every line succeeded.

purpose: 同一输入展示合法转义身份、两类损坏错误、批次回滚与后续查询，保留原始输出和真实非零退出。
